items.prompt: Which definition expresses the lesson's intended metadata symbol rule?

options.text: A column merely called symbol, without constraints
options.why: A meaningful name does not enforce a key.

options.text: An arbitrary first-row selection after every join
options.why: That hides conflicting metadata without a declared repair rule.

options.text: A final DISTINCT without inspecting source duplicates
options.why: That can remove valid repeated events and does not validate source identity.
The two constraints state presence and uniqueness for this key.

items.explanation: Presence and uniqueness are explicit here. The lesson uses the combined constraints rather than depending on SQLite text-primary-key edge cases.
